plan.notes: Official University of Arkansas 2026-27 undergraduate catalog, General Business B.S.B.A. Eight-Semester Degree Program. Semester totals: 16/15/15/16/13/15/15/15 = 120 units (matches catalog 'Total Units in Sequence: 120'). Group 1-8 courses are one course each selected from program-defined course groups (see program requirements: catalog.uark.edu/undergraduatecatalog/collegesandschools/sammwaltoncollegeofbusiness/). ECON slots in semesters 2 and 3 take ECON 22003 and ECON 21003 in either order. All pre-business requirements must be met by end of term 4. Junior/Senior Business Electives = 15 hours total. Courses in bold must be taken in the designated semester.
